ModMetaData.name: Transporter Loadouts
ModMetaData.author: Luke
ModMetaData.description:
Every transporter and shuttle remembers its own default cargo. Set up a shuttle once as a supply runner - "50 meals + 100 chemfuel" - and that manifest is pre-filled every time you open its load dialog, so you never re-tick the same items again.
Each transporter keeps its own loadout, so one can be your supply runner and another your artillery drop. Loadouts are stored in the save, per shuttle.
- Open a transporter's load dialog and its saved default cargo is filled in automatically (clamped to what you have on the map). - Save the current item selection as that transporter's default with one click, or clear it. - Unloading a shuttle keeps its default cargo aboard, so you don't reload the basics every mission.
Works with the vanilla load dialog, so it covers drop pods, shuttles (including modded craft) - anything with a transporter comp. No DLC required.
MULTIPLAYER Built with the Multiplayer mod in mind; loadout changes are synced. Runs fine without Multiplayer installed.
